_calibration_note: claude-opus-5 cache_write split into cache_write_1h and cache_write_5m after fix-round-1 review (Finding 1). Original single cache_write=6.25 assumed 5-minute TTL and overpriced 1-hour-TTL cache writes by 1.6x. Calibrated against a real claude -p usage payload: usage.cache_creation = {ephemeral_1h_input_tokens: 14888, ephemeral_5m_input_tokens: 0}, reported costUSD 0.1565825. price_entry now reads usage['cache_creation']['ephemeral_1h_input_tokens'] / ['ephemeral_5m_input_tokens'] when that sub-object is present, and only falls back to pricing the flat 'cache_creation_input_tokens' bucket at the 1h rate when it is absent. cache_write_1h = 2x input (standard 1-hour TTL multiplier); cache_write_5m = 1.25x input (standard 5-minute TTL multiplier), applied uniformly across models per documented Anthropic caching economics. Real calibration data exists only for claude-opus-5; sonnet-5 and haiku rates are the standard multipliers, unverified against observed cost. This note is nested outside the 'models' object (not a sibling key needing convention-based filtering) so it can never be mistaken for a model's rate card by a pricing[canonical] lookup.
